findings.title: Backup archive is publicly accessible
findings.description: Anyone can download the whole site, including configuration and data.
findings.recommendation: Remove it from the web root and keep backups elsewhere.
findings.evidence: GET /backup.zip returned HTTP 200 with matching content

findings.title: .env file is publicly accessible
findings.description: It usually holds database passwords and API keys.
findings.recommendation: Remove the file from the web root and block dot-files and backups in the server config. Then rotate every secret that was in it.
findings.evidence: GET /.env returned HTTP 200 with matching content

findings.title: .git folder is publicly accessible
findings.description: Anyone can download the site's source code and history, often including passwords.
findings.recommendation: Block access to /.git (nginx: location ~ /\.git { deny all; }) or do not deploy it.
findings.evidence: GET /.git/HEAD returned HTTP 200 with matching content

findings.title: Database dump is publicly accessible
findings.description: It contains the site's data, possibly including user accounts.
findings.recommendation: Remove it from the web root and keep backups elsewhere.
findings.evidence: GET /backup.sql returned HTTP 200 with matching content

findings.title: Directory listing is enabled
findings.description: Visitors can browse the folder and download files that were never linked.
findings.recommendation: Disable it (Apache: Options -Indexes, nginx: autoindex off).

findings.title: phpinfo() page is publicly accessible
findings.description: It shows the PHP version, modules, paths and server settings to attackers.
findings.evidence: GET /phpinfo.php returned HTTP 200 with matching content

findings.title: Page can be framed (clickjacking)
findings.description: Another site can load this page in an invisible frame and trick visitors into clicking buttons on it.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN), or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Without a CSP, any script injected into a page (XSS) runs with no browser-side limits.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.description: Browsers may guess file types and run an upload as a script.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Full page URLs (which can contain tokens or IDs) may be sent to other sites.

findings.title: Server header reveals a software version
findings.description: Attackers can look up known vulnerabilities for the exact version.
findings.recommendation: Hide the version (Apache: ServerTokens Prod, nginx: server_tokens off).

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Browser features like camera, microphone and geolocation are not explicitly limited.
